title: Kraken's Hideaway Vacation Rental
meta_description: Kraken's Hideaway is a 6.00 bedroom, 6.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Welcome to Kraken's Hideaway at 73 Holly Street, a stunning coastal retreat located in the heart of Old Seagrove Beach. This three-story luxury home combines elegant design, spacious gathering areas, and thoughtful amenities to create a relaxing and memorable stay for families and groups. Just a short walk from the beach and minutes from Seaside, this property offers both privacy and proximity to 30A’s most beloved attractions.Property Highlights 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Parking for 3 Vehicles (Garage Access Not Available) Elevator Multiple Dining & Living Areas Inside & Out Gourmet Kitchen with Dual Dishwashers Wet Bars on Each Level of the Home Two Laundry Rooms Two Full-Sized Arcade Games & Ping Pong Table Two Natural Gas Grills Exterior Shower Screened Porch Fourth Floor Observation Space Private Pool with Spa (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1–May 1) Located in the Heart of Old Seagrove 5 Minute Bike Ride to Seaside 4 Minute Walk to Beach Access Experience the Home Nestled in the heart of Old Seagrove Beach, Kraken's Hideaway offers an elegant coastal retreat that blends timeless luxury with playful energy. The home’s bold exterior mural sets the tone for an experience filled with creativity, comfort, and refined design. This spacious six-bedroom sanctuary was built for families and groups seeking an unforgettable stay near the beach and Seaside’s charming town center. The first-floor welcomes guests with a relaxed coastal vibe. Two inviting guest bedrooms, including a large bunk room designed with children in mind, create ideal spaces for rest and connection. A recreation area opens directly to the private pool, offering a seamless transition between indoor leisure and outdoor fun. Sliding glass doors reveal a sparkling pool with an attached spa, surrounded by comfortable seating and an exterior shower for easy rinsing after a day on the sand. Upstairs, the second floor serves as the main gathering level. The open-concept great room brings everyone together with a fully equipped gourmet kitchen featuring dual dishwashers, a large island, and high-end appliances. Two comfortable living areas offer plenty of room for conversation and relaxation, while a spacious dining area sets the stage for memorable meals. The screened porch, located just off the great room, includes an outdoor dining setup, gas grill, and swinging daybed for peaceful evenings overlooking the pool. A luxurious king guest suite with a private balcony completes this level. The third floor continues the home’s thoughtful design with another bunk room, a king guest suite, and a private laundry area for added convenience. The crown jewel of this level is the primary suite, a serene retreat featuring a spa-inspired bathroom with a soaking tub and walk-in shower, a private loggia, and direct access to a rooftop deck. From here, guests can take in panoramic Gulf views and evening sunsets, creating an idyllic end to each day. Every detail at Kraken’s Hideaway has been designed with comfort and entertainment in mind. Multiple wet bars, two full-sized arcade games, and generous indoor and outdoor living areas provide endless ways to enjoy time together. With bikes included and the beach just a short walk away, guests can explore Seaside and 30A’s scenic paths at their own pace.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Half Bath Laundry Room Pool Recreation Room Guest Bedroom: King Bed (sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds (sleeps 4) and One Full-over-Full Bunk Bed (sleeps 4), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Second Floor Kitchen Two Living Areas Dining Area Half Bath Guest Bedroom: King Bed (sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub Third Floor Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds (sleeps 4) and One Full-over-Full Bunk Bed (sleeps 4), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Guest Bedroom: King Bed (sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Primary Bedroom: King Bed (sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub Laundry Room Half Bath Life in Seagrove Seagrove offers a rare blend of relaxed beach living and convenient access to the best of Scenic 30A. Just minutes from Seaside’s shops and dining, guests can enjoy local favorites, explore nearby parks, or take a short stroll to the sugar-white sands of the Gulf. With its prime location, private pool, and spacious design, Kraken's Hideaway at 73 Holly Street is an ideal destination for families and groups looking to experience the charm and beauty of Florida’s Emerald Coast.
